text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Classes are over! I did my best in<n>training again!
#ItsBreakTime for<n>#CuteCurrenChan"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Great work, Curren Chan! Where are you<n>heading
now?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! ♪ I'm off to find the kind of<n>cuteness that
can put a smile on<n>everyone's face! ☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Sh-she's so cute!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is Curren Chan. She uses the handle<n>"Curren"
on social media and is<n>incredibly popular.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the moment, however, another<n>Umamusume is
gazing intently at her<n>from a distance...
choice_data_list:
Do you need to talk to Curren about something,
Yaeno?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Waaagh!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You startled me... Please refrain from<n>doing that.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ahem... You asked whether I have<n>business with
Curren, yes? The answer is<n>that I do not.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, I find that Curren carries<n>herself in a
splendid manner, and thus I<n>decided to observe
her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Despite leading a busy life with an<n>arduous
training regimen, she still<n>manages to maintain a
high frequency of<n>posts on Umastagram.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And the quality of her content remains<n>
consistently high. As a result, her<n>Umasta page is
extremely cute.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hm?! I... I would not claim to be a fan.<n>As a
practitioner of the Kongo Yaegaki<n>style, my heart
remains steadfast!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Well, p-perhaps it wavers slightly... but<n>Curren
does not rely on her innate<n>cuteness alone—she is
always refining<n>her craft...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And that is why I hold the utmost<n>respect for her.
I hesitate to call myself a<n>fan, however—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm? Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea you were a fan of mine,<n>Yaeno. I'm
so happy! My heart skipped a<n>beat just now! ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
We should totally run together<n>sometime! I hope
you'll keep cheering<n>me on! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I want to protect you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I can deny it no longer! I simply cannot<n>bear to
forsake so lovely a flower!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I must protect you using my Kongo<n>Yaegaki style!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I implore you! Please allow me to defend<n>you from
harm!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wow, this is amazing! ♪ Have I finally<n>reached
bodyguard-level popularity?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I don't know what to do! I'm really<n>pleased
you want to keep me safe, but I<n>think having
security might be a teensy<n>bit much...
choice_data_list: It'll be fine! Let her protect you!
Maybe you should try calming her down first.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right! I've gotta match the<n>energy of
my fans!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Will you protect my cuteness, Yaeno?<n>Pretty
please! ☆

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for agreeing to this interview<n>Curren
Chan. It's very much appreciated.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You're very welcome. ♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: S-so first off... Um, uhh...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, who is that intimidating individual<n>behind
you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno is my valiant knight. ☆

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Your "knight"?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Great idea! I'm just so cute that she can't<n>think
straight! Okay, so what should I<n>do?
choice_data_list: You're going to have to say uncute things!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Whaaat? I don't think I know how. ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I mean, I've never not been cute—noteven for a millisecond! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan is so CUUUTE!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan later tells me that, perhaps<n>due to
Yaeno Muteki's intimidating aura,<n>the reporter's
questions were far less<n>pointed than usual.
